lines.text: Marco planned a December sunset at Glacier Point in Yosemite.
A few miles up, the road was gated.
In winter, Glacier Point Road is usually closed beyond the Badger Pass ski area until late spring.
For a winter view, stop at Tunnel View on the Wawona Road instead.
Carry tire chains and check road status on nps.gov that morning.
He watched El Capitan turn gold.
Save this before your Yosemite trip.
